thread:
hazel: EdgeGrid (HW partner) requested a privacy-first Datadog + OpenTelemetry bundle for their appliance marketplace tile. They want a short ops checklist, sampling defaults, and a 20s dashboard GIF for the tile. Demo scheduled Tue.

omar: Recommend collector-side forwarding (otelcol -> datadog) so telemetry can be sanitized locally. Default sampling: 0.5% global, 100% for errors and traces tagged with incident=true. Per-tenant override allowed.

lee: I'll build the dashboard JSON + GIF. Panels: overall QPS, p50/p95 latency, GPU util/mem, token-rate aggregate (no raw prompt text), and a trace flamegraph row.

tara: Docs/packaging note: DO NOT include API keys; use placeholders and link to our docs for setup. Legal: no partner logos in tile until co-marketing signoff. I'll own the marketplace PR.

omar: Minimal collector example for README:
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  attributes/transform:
    actions:
      - key: http.request.body
        action: delete
      - key: user.email
        action: delete
      - key: prompt
        action: delete
exporters:
  datadog:
    apikey: "<DATADOG_APIKEY_PLACEHOLDER>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [attributes/transform]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

omar: Quick env snippet we can include for the instrumented service:
```bash
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4317
export OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=service.name=edge-infer,environment=onprem
```

lee: Small instrumentation guidance: never record full prompt text. Use a hash + length. Python example:
```python
import hashlib
span.set_attribute("prompt.hash", hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest())
span.set_attribute("prompt.length", len(prompt))
```

tara: Preflight checklist for customers (short):
- open port 4317 between svc -> collector
- otelcol running: `systemctl status otelcol` or `otelcol --config /etc/otel/config.yaml --log-level info`
- datadog-agent status: `datadog-agent status`
- collector logs: `journalctl -u otelcol -f`
- verify model.version mapping -> datadog tag `model_version`

hazel: Can we include a small canary script that emits labeled traces so partners can verify mapping quickly?

omar: Yes. I'll drop a tiny canary in the repo that emits spans with model.id, model.version, request_id, batch_size, seq_len, kv_cache_hit=true/false. It will default to 100 traces.

ci-bot: deploy: observability-edge-harness v0.3 deployed to staging (tag: edgegrid-demo-2026-03) :rocket:

lee: Timeline: Omar will post collector + canary by Fri EOD. I post dashboard JSON + GIF by Mon AM. Tara opens marketplace PR Mon PM. Hazel will coordinate demo with EdgeGrid.

tara: One more ops caveat: token-level metrics are high-cardinality. Recommend exporting token counters aggregated by model.id every 60s, not per-request. We'll include an example metric schema in the README.

hazel: Thanks — I'll confirm demo presenters and send invite. Closing actions into the PR. :white_check_mark:
